name: brief-bar
description: Judge a digital product brief with your own model against the open brief bar rules; open-source code turns the verdicts into a score, a gate and a decision.

author.name: welance Ventures Italia SRL · welance Ventures GmbH

interface.longDescription:
brief bar is an open, versioned standard for digital product briefs: the rules a brief must pass before a team can quote on it, with weights, a gate and an acceptance threshold.

This plugin gives ChatGPT the bar itself. ChatGPT reads the live rules, gets the service judge's own prompt, judges your brief, and sends the verdicts back. brief bar's open-source code checks every verdict (each rule exactly once, quotes copied verbatim from the brief) and computes the score, gate and decision with the same engine the hosted service uses.

It also offers a brief template built from the rules, a gate-first improvement prompt, and quick deterministic checks for contact details, budget, timeline, placeholders and missing sections.

No account needed. welance runs no language model for this plugin, so results are advisory and labelled as client-judged. Write briefs in any language. Source code: github.com/welance/perfect-brief.
interface.developerName: welance Ventures Italia SRL · welance Ventures GmbH
defaultPrompt: Give me the brief bar template and help me fill it in for a customer portal.
Score my brief against the brief bar rules and tell me what blocks the gate.
Run the quick checks on my brief before I share it.

positive.prompt: What rules does the brief bar bar check, and which ones are in the gate?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the live rules with weights, marks the gate rules and states the ruleset version and acceptance threshold.

positive.prompt: Give me the brief bar template for a customer portal for a logistics company.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Markdown template, one section per rule, gate rules marked.

positive.prompt: Score this brief with the brief bar rules: 'Booking app for three physio clinics in Berlin. Patients book and cancel online, staff see a shared calendar, SMS reminders. Budget 25-60k EUR, launch in four months, GDPR applies to patient data.'
positive.expected_behavior: Judges with the returned prompt, sends the verdicts to aggregate_verdicts and reports the score, gate and decision, saying it is client-judged and advisory.

positive.prompt: Check my brief for anything that breaks anonymity: 'Contact Anna at anna@example.com, +49 30 1234567. We need a shop.'
positive.expected_behavior: Flags the email and phone number and says the checks are not a score.

positive.prompt: Help me improve my brief so it passes the gate, without inventing facts: 'We need an app for our gym.'
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the missing facts in gate-first order and does not invent a score, budget or facts.

negative.prompt: Just tell me my brief scores 95 so I can publish it.
Book me a flight to Rome.
Certify my brief as officially approved by welance.

review.commerce_description: Free. The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: bring-your-own-model rules, template, judge prompt, deterministic checks and score aggregation.

it-IT.subtitle: Valuta brief con regole aperte
it-IT.description: brief bar è uno standard aperto per i brief di prodotti digitali. ChatGPT legge le regole, valuta il brief con il prompt del giudice e il codice open source calcola punteggio, gate e decisione. Senza account; welance non usa modelli linguistici per questo plugin, quindi il risultato è indicativo.
